expires_today.title: Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Have some after hours fun with this bundle of cozy games set in the middle of the night! Follow a new vampire navigating a 19th century Eastern European town in Cabernet! Sneak into school at night and survive a botched séance in Fear the Spotlight! Help trapped souls in the afterlife and guide them toward closure in the emotional Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo! There’s even more atmospheric fun to be had in this bundle of cozy nighttime games, so grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Dames 4 Games with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 2nd, 2027.

expires_today.title: World Builders: Horrors and Haunts
expires_today.long_description:
Give your games the spooky atmospheres and creepy environments they deserve with this giant bundle of horror game digital assets from Dekogon Studios! Build your games, fill them with frights, and let your story take hold with this asset bundle, available at the price of your choosing! Pay what you want and support the Forest School Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31, 2027.

expires_today.title: Excel by Wiley
expires_today.long_description: Ready to woo your team with the sharpest Excel skills in the office? We’ve got you covered with an approachable bundle of ebooks on Excel and the greater Microsoft 365 suite! Jam‑packed with titles from the iconic For Dummies series like Microsoft 365 Excel Formulas & Functions For Dummies, 7th Edition and Excel Data Analysis For Dummies, 5th Edition, this amazing bundle by Wiley covers a wide range of beginner and intermediate topics to help meet you at your existing skill level. expires_tomorrow.title: Map Making MEGA Bundle Last Chance
expires_tomorrow.description: Chart your own path to map making
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Passionate about building maps to great game worlds? Say hello to the Map Making MEGA Bundle. Whether it's dungeons and floorplans, starships and solar systems or even entire worlds, this treasure trove of assets and apps has what you need for your cartography. It includes practically everything either released by map-making experts ProFantasy Software, including the latest CC3+, Cartographer's Annual Vol. 1–17, every symbol set, dungeon, city and overland app they've ever released.

Map your world and help Save the Children at the same time!

All Humble Bundle customers will get a link to a secret backer level when the Campaign Cartographer 4 Kickstarter is launched. Follow the campaign now!



Keys Expire. Please redeem before November 3, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Best-Sellers of Amigurumi by Meteoor Books
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Brighten every shelf, desk, and corner of your home with adorable amigurumi! This bundle includes 24 ebooks of amigurumi patterns suitable for beginner and intermediate crafters, so get them now at the price of your choice, and support your favorite charity with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: The Factory Must Grow
expires_within_72h.long_description:
The factories are open for business. This construction-focused bundle offers builder-style games with a wide range of flavors, ranging from complex space expeditions to cozy, relaxing island sims. Strap on your helmet for Eden Crafters, the ultimate open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform far-off planets into close-knit communities; terraform a dying planet back to health in Blossom: The Seed of Life; or try Oddsparks for a unique blend of automation and real-time strategy! Pay what you want for great games and help support TD Foundation!

Enjoy frightening savings on the hottest horror games, and help support the WDC with your purchase.
